title: Ijwi Riciye mu Bitandara
intro: Tekereza ikiyaya aho amazu yo kubamwo abajwe mu bitandara, kandi ikirere kigatwara iciyumviro c’imburi umuntu atayiyumviriye. Igihugu carigeze gutera imbere hano, gihezagiwe ariko kikaba gitera ubwoba, gushika aho ikimenyetso kiva mu rutare nyene bari bizigiye.
clues: Twari abantu babaza amazu atekanye bavuye mu misozi, tukaba twumva dutekanye mu mazu yacu y’ibitandara.
Twabaye mu gihugu c’ibiyaya n’amabuye, gihezagiwe n’amatongo n’amasoko.
Haje intumwa ivuye muri twebwe, iduhamagara ngo duhebe imana zacu z’ibinyoma, dusenge Umuremyi umwe w’ukuri.
Twarashizeho n’ubwibone ikintu co kwemera: ikimenyetso kidasanzwe cova mu bitandara nyene twabaje.

Igihe ingamiya y’ingore yasezeranywe yaboneka iva ku rutare, ikimenyetso gitomoye, abahinga bacu baracariko barayanka maze barayitera umugongo naho bari baragabishijwe ko hari urupfu rwari rugiye gushika.
Haciye imisi itatu ivyo twakoze, inkuba yaravuze mu kiyaya, maze turacika ibisigazwa vy’ibintu vyaguye, amazu yacu akaba imva zacu.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
